name: Disneyland Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe Roast Beef & White Cheddar on Toasted Roll (Hold Horseradish!)
brandOrRestaurant: Jolly Holiday Bakery Cafe (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Thin-sliced roast beef and naturally low-lactose aged white cheddar on a soft toasted bakery roll make a high-protein meal once you skip the pungent horseradish aioli and caramelized onions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Roast Beef & White Cheddar Sandwich and remove/hold the horseradish aioli, caramelized onions, and arugula.
watchOuts: Horseradish and arugula are pungent gut irritants—eat just the roast beef, aged white cheddar, and soft roll
